requirements.title: Front and rear seats comfortable for long drives across body sizes
requirements.statement: The front seats shall allow a pain-free two-hour drive for drivers from 1.60 m to 1.90 m, including a lumbar support that can be set completely flat, and the rear seat cushion and backrest shall match the comfort of the front seats.
requirements.recommend_rationale: Seats are the largest complaint theme of the interior (62 complaint rows, 2.4 % of all US complaints, level A) and both study attributes sit below the peer: front seat comfort 5.74 vs 6.04, rear seat comfort 5.27 vs 6.24. Verbatims name back pain, firmness and a lumbar support that cannot be flattened.
requirements.horizon_rationale: Cushion, contour and lumbar calibration change within the life-cycle impulse; no new architecture needed.

criteria.method: Customer feedback sources A-D, rolling 6 months

criteria.target: Can be set to a completely flat position

assumptions: Study scores of the next wave are comparable with the 2025 wave.
uncertainties: Comfort perception differs between ICE (71 rows) and BEV (38 rows) buyers; the split is small.

findings.title: Overall comfort of the seats: weak study rating (5.74)
Comfort of 2nd row seat: weak study rating (5.27)
Adjustment of lower lumbar support: 6 complaints (unmet need)
Seats: wished or criticised, related equipment is optional or missing

requirements.title: Climate control direct, strong enough for US heat, and remembers its settings
requirements.statement: Temperature and fan speed shall have a physical or always-visible control; recirculation, zone sync and seat-ventilation defaults shall persist per driver profile across drives; the system shall cool the cabin from a heat-soaked state within an agreed time.
requirements.recommend_rationale: Climate setting is a level-A complaint (24 rows) supported by the study attribute climate controls usability (4.80); blower (19) and control panel (17) complaints add hidden vents, weak airflow and settings that reset after every drive.
requirements.horizon_rationale: Persistence and control placement are software; vent and blower tuning fit the life-cycle impulse.

criteria.target: Recirculation, sync and seat ventilation default kept per profile

findings.title: Operation of heater/ AC controls: weak study rating (4.8)
Air conditioning control panel: 17 complaints (recurring complaint)

requirements.title: Interior materials that match the price class
requirements.statement: Door panels, dashboard and trim within reach shall use soft-touch or leather materials, and a full-leather upholstery option shall be offered.
requirements.recommend_rationale: Upholstery and trim is level A (20 rows) and supported by the study attribute interior material quality (5.62 vs 5.95); door panels add 19 rows. Owners compare the cabin with the previous generation and with Audi.
requirements.horizon_rationale: Material and option changes within the life-cycle impulse.

findings.title: Quality of interior materials: weak study rating (5.62)
Door, finisher panel, front: 19 complaints (recurring complaint)
Upholstery / interior trim: wished or criticised, related equipment is optional or missing

requirements.title: Frequently used functions reachable with one touch or a physical control
requirements.statement: Climate temperature and fan, seat and steering wheel heating, drive mode, start-stop, assistance on/off, volume, map and phone shall each be operable with one touch or a physical control while driving, without leaving the current screen.
requirements.recommend_rationale: The operating concept is a level-A recurring complaint (53 rows, 39 of them usability) and is linked to the study attribute infotainment menu structure (4.88). Touch screen (35 rows) and instrument cluster (38 rows) complaints repeat the same pattern: functions are buried in menus and pull the eyes off the road.
requirements.horizon_rationale: Mostly software (shortcut layer, widget placement); physical controls only where the panel allows them in the life-cycle impulse.

criteria.metric: Touches to reach each of the ten listed functions while driving

uncertainties: Part of the criticism is unfamiliarity; onboarding (REQ-G60-US-GE-01) may reduce it without HMI changes.

findings.title: Operating concept, operating system: 53 complaints (recurring complaint)
Menu structure of infotainment system: weak study rating (4.88)

requirements.title: Phone integration that just works
requirements.statement: Apple CarPlay shall connect to the phone of the active driver profile, play at the same loudness as the native sources, and wireless charging shall keep the phone charged without overheating.
requirements.recommend_rationale: Apple CarPlay (37 rows, 12 defects) and wireless charging (26 rows, level A, 11 defects, supported by the study attribute phone charging) are among the most frequent digital complaints; low CarPlay volume and the wrong phone connecting are repeated themes.
requirements.horizon_rationale: Software and charger thermal management.

criteria.metric: CarPlay audio level vs native sources
criteria.target: Within 3 dB at the same volume step
Phone of the active profile in >= 98 % of starts
Battery level does not drop over 60 min at 30 °C cabin

findings.title: Mobile device, wireless charging: 26 complaints (recurring complaint)
Manage / pair mobile device (Bluetooth): 11 complaints (recurring complaint)

requirements.title: Practical storage for everyday items
requirements.statement: The cabin shall provide seat-back pockets, a sunglasses holder, a covered console tray and a glove box and door pockets that take a bottle and an umbrella.
requirements.recommend_rationale: Storage compartments (28 rows, half of them wishes) and front centre console (30 rows) are level-A findings supported by the study attribute interior storage (5.15 vs peer 5.33); owners miss the removed seat-back pockets and sunglasses holder.
requirements.horizon_rationale: Trim parts within the life-cycle impulse.

requirements.title: Keyless access on all four doors and easy door handling
requirements.statement: Comfort access shall lock and unlock from all four door handles, the doors shall close without slamming and the handles shall be easy to find in the dark.
requirements.recommend_rationale: Door open/close is level A (31 rows) and linked to the study attribute rear entry/exit (5.41 vs 6.0); comfort access (30 rows, 17 wishes) and lock/unlock (38 rows) complain that the rear doors lost the touch sensor of earlier generations.
requirements.horizon_rationale: Rear handle sensors and closing-force tuning fit the life-cycle impulse.

criteria.target: 4 of 4 where comfort access is fitted
Closes fully without slamming (value to be set by engineering)

findings.title: Ease of 2nd row seat entry: weak study rating (5.41)

requirements.title: Adaptive cruise control as standard and simple assistance controls
requirements.statement: Adaptive cruise control shall be standard; following distance, lane keeping and assistance on/off shall be adjustable with one control while driving.
requirements.recommend_rationale: Active cruise control (23 rows) and parking assistant (22 rows) complaints mention paying extra for functions expected as standard and awkward controls; the catalogue offers Driving Assistant Plus only as an option (1,000 EUR, 0 of 10 variants standard).
requirements.horizon_rationale: Hardware is fitted; standard content and HMI are a product decision.

criteria.metric: Variants with adaptive cruise control as standard

criteria.target: One control on the steering wheel

uncertainties: The catalogue is the German price list; US standard content may differ.

findings.title: (Active) cruise control: wished or criticised, related equipment is optional or missing

requirements.title: Personal drive mode that is really personal
requirements.statement: The personal mode shall let the driver combine steering, suspension, throttle, sound and energy settings freely, hide unused modes and start in the last chosen mode.
requirements.recommend_rationale: My Modes draws 36 complaint rows, 15 of them wishes: owners want to start in sport or efficient mode and to configure the personal mode instead of fixed presets.
requirements.horizon_rationale: Software.

findings.title: My Modes / driving experience: 36 complaints (recurring complaint)

requirements.title: Progressive brake pedal feel and predictable recuperation
requirements.statement: Brake pedal response shall be progressive without an initial grab, and lifting off the accelerator shall decelerate the car predictably, with an option for one-pedal driving to a standstill.
requirements.recommend_rationale: Braking draws 37 complaint rows (28 usability: grabbing, poor modulation) and recuperation 13 rows asking for consistent engine braking and a full stop in one-pedal mode.
requirements.horizon_rationale: Brake-by-wire and recuperation calibration.

criteria.target: Car stops and holds without the brake pedal in the strongest mode

findings.title: Brake Energy Regeneration / recuperation: 13 complaints (recurring complaint)

requirements.title: Keep the handling and ride character in the next generation
requirements.statement: The successor shall keep the handling precision and ride composition that customers praise today.
requirements.recommend_rationale: Handling and riding is the strongest praise theme (210 likes) and handling/manoeuvrability scores above the peer (6.06 vs 5.62); a strength to protect, not to change.
requirements.horizon_rationale: Applies to the chassis of the successor generation.

findings.title: Handling / Riding: strength to keep (210 likes)

requirements.title: Guided onboarding for a feature-rich car
requirements.statement: Every new owner shall get an in-car guided tour and a searchable, model-specific help function that explains the ten most used functions within the first week.
requirements.recommend_rationale: The largest single complaint cluster (98 rows, 63 usability) is about the car being hard to figure out; owner's manual complaints (16 rows) add that the manual is hard to search.
requirements.horizon_rationale: Software and content.

criteria.metric: Owners who completed the guided tour in week 1

findings.title: Body equipment, overall technology: 98 complaints (recurring complaint)

requirements.title: Driver profiles and settings survive updates and shared use
requirements.statement: Personal settings shall survive over-the-air updates; each profile shall support at least two keys or phones, and the car shall recognise the right driver when two key holders approach together.
requirements.recommend_rationale: Driver profile complaints (25 rows) and software update complaints (15 rows) report seat memories, wake words and assistance settings wiped by updates and the wrong profile loaded.
requirements.horizon_rationale: Software.

criteria.metric: User settings kept after an OTA update

requirements.title: Auto start-stop can be switched off permanently by the driver
requirements.statement: Drivers of ICE and mild-hybrid variants shall be able to switch auto start-stop off with one control and keep it off across drives in their profile; the restart shall not jolt the car.
requirements.recommend_rationale: 45 complaint rows, all from ICE drivers (1.7 % of US complaints): the function cannot be disabled permanently, cuts in too early and feels harsh and unsafe at intersections.
requirements.horizon_rationale: Software setting and calibration, deliverable over the air.

criteria.metric: Start-stop off setting kept after ignition off

uncertainties: Fuel economy certification credits may constrain a persistent off setting; legal check needed.

findings.title: Automatic engine start-stop function (MSA): 45 complaints (recurring complaint)

requirements.title: Reliable range prediction and cold-weather range guidance for BEV and PHEV
requirements.statement: The displayed remaining range shall stay within an agreed tolerance of the real range in cold weather, and the car shall explain the expected winter range and the effect of pre-conditioning before a trip.
requirements.recommend_rationale: Electric range is the second-largest powertrain complaint (67 rows, 2.6 %, 83 of them BEV); verbatims report estimates that are "off" and range that collapses in winter.
requirements.horizon_rationale: Range estimation and guidance are software.

criteria.metric: Deviation of displayed vs actual range at 0 °C

criteria.target: Shown before departure when the trip exceeds 70 % of predicted range

requirements.title: More real-world electric range in the successor generation
requirements.statement: The successor of the i5 shall offer a usable real-world range that covers typical US long-distance stages without a charging stop, including in cold weather.
requirements.recommend_rationale: Range wishes (17 rows) and usability complaints (50 rows) ask for 350 to 400 miles; the battery capacity of the current generation cannot be raised within the life cycle.
requirements.horizon_rationale: Needs a new cell and pack generation.

criteria.metric: EPA range of the volume BEV variant

assumptions: Customer wishes of 350 to 400 miles in the verbatims represent the US BEV buyer.

requirements.title: Dependable public fast charging on US trips
requirements.statement: BEV owners shall be able to use the Tesla Supercharger (NACS) network without improvising, the route planner shall prefer stations that are reported working, and the car shall hold its advertised peak charging power for a meaningful part of the session.
requirements.recommend_rationale: Public charging draws 55 complaint rows (65 BEV mentions) and battery charging 31 more: broken stations, no NACS access, slow sessions and charge cut-offs make long trips stressful.
requirements.horizon_rationale: Adapter, network agreement and route-planner logic do not need a new vehicle generation.

criteria.target: Adapter supplied or available at delivery; Supercharger usable from the car

criteria.metric: Planned stops at stations reported out of order

uncertainties: Third-party network reliability is outside BMW's direct control.

findings.title: Public charging / external providers: 55 complaints (recurring complaint)
Charge high-voltage battery: wished or criticised, related equipment is optional or missing

requirements.title: Charging flap opens reliably in every condition
requirements.statement: The charge port cover shall open on the first request whenever the car is unlocked, including in frost.
requirements.recommend_rationale: 20 complaint rows with 13 defects (BEV 19); owners report being stranded because the flap stays locked.
requirements.horizon_rationale: Field fix of the actuator and its software.

findings.title: Opening/closing charging socket cover: 20 complaints (recurring complaint)

requirements.title: Hands-free tailgate opens on the first kick and closes from inside
requirements.statement: The hands-free tailgate shall open on the first foot movement and the trunk shall have a close button on the lid.
requirements.recommend_rationale: Non-contact trunk opening is one of the largest single usability complaints (44 rows, 39 usability); trunk lid open/close adds 18 rows with 9 defects.
requirements.horizon_rationale: Sensor calibration and a close button fit the life-cycle impulse.

criteria.target: Present on every variant with power tailgate

findings.title: non-contact trunk lid opening: 44 complaints (recurring complaint)
Trunk lid, open / close: 18 complaints (recurring complaint)

requirements.title: Factory CD player
requirements.statement: Offer a factory CD player.
requirements.recommend_rationale: Seven explicit wishes, all from ICE owners; physical media is declining and the cabin has no package space for it. Kept visible so the PM can confirm the rejection.
